header.title: Learner Management Buttons
header.description: Show or hide the built-in Enroll / Invite buttons and add custom link buttons (e.g. an invite link or sub-org learner registration link) to the Learner Management header.

customButtons.title: Custom buttons
customButtons.empty: No custom buttons. Add one to surface an invite link or sub-org learner registration link in the header.

url.label: Custom URL
url.hint: Opens the link you enter below.

suborgLearnerInvite.label: Sub-org learner invite link
suborgLearnerInvite.hint: Auto-fills the sub-org learner invite for the course being viewed. Shows only for a sub-org admin on a course’s Learner tab — learners who enroll through it appear in the sub-org admin’s learner list.

courseInvite.label: Course learner invite link
courseInvite.hint: Auto-fills the course’s default learner invite link for the course being viewed.
